title: Nazca and Paracas cranial elongation rituals

tellings.quote: The final thing that the Nazca and Paracas people practiced were cranial deformation or skull elongation rituals.

plain: The Nazca and Paracas, ancient peoples of southern Peru, are said to have practised rituals that reshaped and lengthened the skull. Michels tells this himself, without naming a source, as one of the customs of those cultures, in an episode about strange three-fingered bodies found in Peru, where it bears on whether odd-looking remains from the region could be explained by such human practices.
